name: vicarius
title: Vicarius vRx
description: Imports remediation status from Vicarius vRx via the External Data API. VICARIUS_MODE is a list of views to fan out (defaults to 'cves') — valid values: assets (asset inventory and OS/endpoint metadata) | cves (active vulnerabilities grouped by vulnerabilityId, each emitted as a Faraday vuln on every affected host) | patches (missing patches per endpoint) | software (installed publisher/product/version inventory, emitted as severity-info findings tagged 'software-inventory') | incidents (DetectedVulnerability / MitigatedVulnerability events — mitigated events arrive with status='closed' so this mode supplements cves by auto-closing vulns vRx has remediated). VICARIUS_API_URL and VICARIUS_TOKEN can be set per-scan (the token is sent as the 'Vicarius-Token' header) or as agent env vars for shared defaults — the per-scan value wins. Pagination is automatic; tune with VICARIUS_FROM (starting cursor), VICARIUS_SIZE (page size, default 500), VICARIUS_MAX_PAGES (hard cap, default 100 = 50k rows per mode). Rate-limit aware: backs off 60s on HTTP 429 up to 3 retries per page. Read-only today — patch execution and external-findings ingest are not exposed by the vRx PAT scope.
